name: ProductList
description:
A variant-driven list of products. Renders its rows through the shared
ProductItem composition; the `variant` selects density/affordances
for the whole list rather than proliferating separate list components.

Layout is delegated to the shared Grid (card variant) and
Stack (row/compact variants) primitives, and the loading state is
composed from the shared Skeleton primitive inside the Card
family — no per-component stylesheet, no raw layout `<div>`, no inline
style, and no hardcoded colors.

props.name: variant
props.description:
Presentation variant applied to the list and propagated to each row.
Drives layout (rows vs. grid of cards) via `data-variant` + tokens only.
Defaults to `row`.
